name: Meremoth
overview: Meremoth is a figure in post-exilic Scripture associated with priestly and covenantal duties in Jerusalem. He is identified as a priest responsible for weighing and registering precious vessels dedicated to God, demonstrating faithful stewardship of sacred items (Ezra 8:33). Additionally, Meremoth is noted as one who sealed the covenant alongside Nehemiah, reflecting his role in the community's commitment to God's law (Nehemiah 10:5; 12:3). The references also include a Meremoth involved in the physical rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls, highlighting active participation in the restoration of the city and its worship (Nehemiah 3:4, 3:21). The mention of a Meremoth who divorced his Gentile wife after the captivity (Ezra 10:36) underscores the community's dedication to covenant purity following the exile.
